scope: All early potion-deferral subsets and AD allocations, at one fixed event/shop schedule; navigation relaxed. Not a full-game or global bound.
assumptions: Keep all non-stat-purchase events and key trades in their prescribed order; buy the same 31 cheap XP stats ASAP.
Buy exactly 12 low-gold stats and high-gold stats ASAP, preserving the source early red-key purchase budget.
Every early potion is either taken at its source position or just after the last white mage.
Ignore movement constraints in the DP; bytecode replay is required for positive witnesses.
Keep maximum HP per ATK/DEF/level/deferred-healing sum; no RNG or seed optimization.
